{{Top|leg}}
'''Danil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], touristic guide and theater doorman operating in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. He was tall, lanky and evasive.

That year, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alec (Jedi)|Alec]] hired Danil as his personal pilot and guide to the city of [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], with Alec providing the ship. Danil, dressed in red, was seen with Alec in the [[Grande Game]] casino and the [[Club 111]], a locale that Danil had repeatedly visited before.

Soon afterward, Alec decided to hide in the [[Five Star Entertainment]] theater, and Danil agreed to be his sentry. Danil had nothing to do until Alec was ready to leave, so Danil got an unsatisfying job as the theater doorman &mdash; that way, Danil could control who was entering the theater. At that point, the theater was playing ''[[A Rodian Love Story]]'', which was not Danil's favorite play.

Once Alec was ready to leave Depatar, he called Danil and both of them, as well as Alec's new allies, traveled to the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], with Danil piloting.
